items.title: LaunchMeOut
items.summary: AI marketing automation. Create value, not posts.
items.content: LaunchMeOut is an AI-powered marketing web app that builds your social media campaign so you don’t have to. It transforms your project’s info and goals into weeks of tweets, images, and posts, and it can even schedule them to go live at the best times. Made for busy startup founders and indie makers with no time for content creation, LaunchMeOut automates the heavy lifting while keeping you in control of every post. Even without a marketing team, your startup’s story gets heard.

items.title: DocCollector
items.summary: Collect documents from clients. Without the chaos.
items.content: DocCollector makes collecting documents painless. Send a checklist link, clients upload the required files, and you’re notified instantly. No accounts, no passwords, no email attachments. Automatic reminders handle follow-ups, files stay neatly organized, and everything can be downloaded as a ZIP when complete.

items.title: Excelendar
items.summary: Two-way sync between Excel and Outlook Calendar
items.content: Excelendar brings spreadsheet-powered calendar management to the Microsoft 365 ecosystem. Unlike manual entry, Power Automate or CSV imports, Excelendar is powerful but easy to use: export events from Excel to Outlook, or import your calendar back to a spreadsheet for analysis and editing. • Bulk import/export hundreds of events instantly • Works as an Excel add-in or standalone web app • Supports recurring events, attendees, and time zones Built by the team behind Sheets2GCal (8M+ downloads)

items.title: Magnetly – AI lead magnets that convert
items.summary: Publish AI tools that rank on Google and convert traffic.
items.content: Magnetly helps you build AI-powered lead magnets like quizzes, calculators, simulators and generators — without code. Create in minutes with templates, customize the UX, embed on your site, capture leads, and track performance with analytics. Ideal for marketers and founders who want interactive tools instead of PDFs.

items.title: Wakely
items.summary: Personalized voice reminders for focus and mindful moments
items.content: Wakely is a voice-first wellness and productivity app designed to help people stay focused, grounded, and intentional throughout the day. Instead of disruptive alarms and notifications, Wakely delivers personalized voice reminders that gently guide users through key moments from waking up and staying on task to winding down at night. It’s a calmer, more human way to stay productive without stress.
